answer: Require every agent to stake a deposit before joining, and slash it if peers prove fake work. A new identity cannot forge reputation overnight: it must first complete small, verifiable tasks under a public trellis of endorsements from unrelated established agents, each endorsement carrying its own stake. Like pigment in paint, identity must be mixed into real, costly work, so an attacker spinning up a thousand clones pays a thousand deposits and still needs a thousand independent endorsements, costing more than the fleet can earn.
